concerns.text: T013d depends on T013a (actual_budget) and T013f (correction factor). However, T013a is defined as running AFTER T014 to capture the 'actual executed budget'. T014 generates the comparison_log.jsonl. T013 reads the log to count wasted pairs. The dependency chain T014 -> T013 -> T013a -> T013d is correct, BUT T013d also depends on T013f which depends on T013e/T013e-proxy. T013e depends on T013c (sample). T013c depends on T013b (sample size). T013b depends on T013 (flagged count). The chain is: T014 -> T013 -> T013b -> T013c -> T013e -> T013f -> T013d. T013a is parallel to T013b-T013f but must complete before T013d. The current dependency list for T013d is '[Dep: T013f, T013a]'. This is correct. However, T013a is marked [P] (parallel-safe) in the text but explicitly depends on T014. The [P] tag is misleading here as it implies no dependencies, but it has a hard data dependency on T014's output. This is a semantic violation of the [P] definition.

T013e (LLM Consensus) is marked [P] in the task list header but the description explicitly states 'This task runs AFTER T014 to ensure comparison_log.jsonl exists' and depends on T013c. The [P] tag is incorrect for T013e, T013f, T013d, T013a, T013b, T013c as they all have strict sequential data dependencies on the log file or previous aggregation steps. Only T013 (counting) and T014 (ranking) might be candidates for parallelization if the log is streamed, but T013 needs the full log. The [P] tags on T013a, T013b, T013c, T013e, T013f, T013d are incorrect and violate the 'Producer before Consumer' rule if interpreted as 'can run in parallel with T014'.

T024a depends on T013e/T013e-proxy. T024 depends on T024a. T021 (pre-clustering filter) depends on T012 and T020. T020 (MinHash) depends on T012. T012 (injection) is in Phase 3. T020 is in Phase 4. This is correct. However, T024a is in Phase 4 but depends on T013e (Phase 3). This is a cross-phase dependency which is allowed, but the task T024a is marked [P] (parallel-safe). It cannot be parallel with T024 (which depends on it) or T021 (which might need the correlation data? No, T021 is independent). But T024a depends on T013e. If T013e is not complete, T024a cannot run. The [P] tag on T024a is acceptable if it means 'can run in parallel with T020/T021', but the description says 'Implement and execute... using the LLM consensus ground truth from T013e'. This implies a hard dependency. The [P] tag is risky if it implies independence from Phase 3 completion.

T031 (Statistical Report) depends on T013d, T013f, T030. T030 (NDCG) depends on T014 (Baseline) and T022 (Clustering). T022 depends on T021 (Pre-clustering). T021 depends on T012 and T020. T013d depends on T013f and T013a. T013f depends on T013e. T013e depends on T013c. T013c depends on T013b. T013b depends on T013. T013 depends on T014. The chain is long and complex. T031 is correctly placed at the end. However, T031 is marked [P] in the task list? No, T031 is not marked [P]. Good. But T028 and T029 (Wilcoxon tests) are marked [P]. T028 depends on T027 (multi-seed execution). T027 depends on T014 and T021 (to run both variants). T021 depends on T012 and T020. T014 depends on T012. So T027 cannot run until T012, T020, T014, T021 are done. T028 and T029 depend on T027. The [P] tag on T028 and T029 is incorrect as they depend on the completion of the multi-seed loop (T027) which is a sequential aggregation of results.
T013a is marked [P] but has a hard dependency on T014. The [P] tag should be removed to avoid confusion about parallel execution capabilities.

T013b, T013c, T013e, T013f, T013d are all marked [P] in the task list (implied by the list format or explicit tags in some cases). They form a strict sequential chain: T013 -> T013b -> T013c -> T013e -> T013f -> T013d. None of these can run in parallel with each other. The [P] tags must be removed from all of them.

T024a is marked [P] but depends on T013e (Phase 3). While it can run in parallel with T020/T021, the [P] tag might be misinterpreted as 'no dependencies'. It is safer to remove [P] or clarify the dependency.
T028 and T029 are marked [P] but depend on T027 (multi-seed execution). T027 is a sequential loop. T028 and T029 must wait for T027 to complete. The [P] tag is incorrect.
